scan_linter_check.description:
Flags code that is built from strings and executed, in any script: eval(), new Function(...), setTimeout/setInterval given a string (or a concatenation containing one), and GlideEvaluator.evaluateString(). Code built from strings can execute attacker-controlled input, cannot be analyzed or debugged, and bypasses review. GlideScopedEvaluator.evaluateScript(), the supported way to run a script stored in a field, is not reported.
Replaces the legacy check "NS: eval() Usage in Scripts", which matched text (including comments).
scan_linter_check.name: SEC-002: Dynamic code execution
scan_linter_check.resolution_details: Do not build code from strings. Use JSON.parse() for data, pass functions (not strings) to setTimeout/setInterval, and call the intended function directly. To run a script stored in a field, use GlideScopedEvaluator.evaluateScript().
scan_linter_check.short_description: Strings run as code: eval(), new Function(), string timers, evaluateString().
